THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down auburn hair — wearing nothing but a gold sequin micro bikini: a tiny front-zip cropped top with the zipper pulled halfway down between the breasts, and an ultra micro bikini bottom tied with thin side strings, every sequin throwing tiny sparkles into the mirrors, every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The outfit sits on her skin with soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy electric orange leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.

Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, a six-wheeled Mars rover with a tall camera mast and solar panels standing on the red rocky desert of Mars, with scattered boulders and a dusty crater rim placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny scientists in orange suits, a tiny drone and tiny rovers around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the red rocky Martian ground, a butterscotch-pink Martian sky with a small pale sun behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm dusty sunlight with soft long shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
